query: SELECT lmf.flow_id, lmf.is_default, COALESCE(array_agg(lmfg.group_id) FILTER (WHERE lmfg.group_id IS NOT NULL), '{}') AS "group_ids!: Vec<Id>" FROM location_mfa_flow lmf LEFT JOIN location_mfa_flow_group lmfg ON lmfg.location_id = lmf.location_id AND lmfg.flow_id = lmf.flow_id WHERE lmf.location_id = $1 GROUP BY lmf.flow_id, lmf.position, lmf.is_default ORDER BY lmf.position
